stories.headline: An AI Breakthrough Has Made Decades of Computer Science Research ‘Irrelevant’
stories.dek: Anthropic and OpenAI say they’ve disproved a key tenet of computer science. Researchers are struggling with the fall but also feel like “overexcited bunnies” as they look at new questions to explore.

stories.headline: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
stories.dek: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.

stories.headline: A Hacker Targeted High-Stakes Poker Players With Malware That Exposed Their Cards
stories.dek: Illicit software on the computers of some of the world’s best online poker players allowed the accused cheater to see what cards were in the victims’ hands—and trounce them at the tables.
